findings.motion: Motion 9 to concur in the House committee substitute and House amendments (Roll Call #439, passed 27-18)
findings.note: Senate vote to accept the House version of SB 747, Various Changes Regarding Elections Law. The bill text (Session Law 2023-140) lets a person register and vote the same day at early voting only with a photo ID plus a listed proof-of-address document (utility bill, bank statement, paycheck or similar), and lists no photo ID at the polls as a ground for a voter challenge. She is listed among the Noes.
subjects: non-photo documents as proof of address

findings.motion: Motion 11, Senate vote to override the Governor's veto of SB 747 (Roll Call #482, passed 30-19)
findings.note: Senate vote to override the Governor's veto of SB 747, Various Changes Regarding Elections Law, including its photo ID requirement for same-day registration. She is listed among the Noes.

findings.motion: Second Reading of HB 958, Election Law Changes (Senate Roll Call #693, passed 28-13)
findings.note: Senate second-reading vote on HB 958, Election Law Changes. The Senate committee substitute (Seventh Edition) includes a rule that a voter registration application must state citizenship under penalty of perjury, and a State Board process to remove voters flagged as possibly non-citizens by a federal database. She is listed among the Noes. The bill history shows no recorded roll call for the third reading.
